historyCaveat: Contemporaneous complete track/going histories were not obtained. No current horse histories or post-race ratings are copied into these fields. History adjustment must be off for the benchmark.

excludedYears.reason: A complete contemporaneous field of comparable Racing & Sports numerical ratings was not obtained. The VRC field article supplies names and barriers but no ratings; the Timeform runner guide supplies narrative analysis, not a complete numeric rating field. Selected Timeform ratings in another pre-race preview do not fill the gaps or establish the same rating basis. Excluded without imputing values.

reviewedSources.availableData: Initial declared 24-runner field and drawn barriers; no numerical ratings.
Timeform runner-by-runner narrative, without a complete numeric rating field.
Timeform preview with selected numeric ratings; not a complete comparable R&S rating field.

excludedYears.reason: The complete VRC pre-race guide explicitly labels all 23 runner ratings as Timeform. The included 2024 and 2025 articles label their values Racing & Sports ratings. No documented crosswalk establishing numerical equivalence was obtained; the different rating basis is excluded rather than silently pooled.

benchmarkProvider.ratingBasis: The numerical Racing & Sports ratings printed in the dated 2024 and 2025 VRC pre-race articles. No weight-adjusted Timeform values or official handicap ratings are substituted.
benchmarkProvider.comparabilityCaveat: A complete older field does not establish a comparable measurement basis. Different named rating systems require a documented crosswalk before pooling.
